title: Agonistic effect of peptides derived from a truncated HMGB1 acidic tail sequence in TLR5 from Salmo salar.
authors: Vasquez-Suarez, Aleikar; Ortega, Leonardo; Gonzalez-Chavarria, Ivan; Valenzuela, Ariel; Munoz-Flores, Carolina; Altamirano, Claudia; Acosta, Jannel; Toledo, Jorge R
one_liner_zh: 该文基于TLR5表面结构设计HMGB1衍生肽并验证其激动活性，涉及蛋白-肽对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Based on the structural knowledge of TLR5 surface and using blind docking platforms, peptides derived from a truncated HMGB1 acidic tail from Salmo salar was designed as TLR5 agonistic. Additionally, a template peptide with the native N-terminal of the acidic tail sequence as a reference was included (SsOri). Peptide binding poses complexed on TLR5 ectodomain model from each algorithm were filtrated based on docking scoring functions and predicted theoretical binding affinity of the complex. The best peptides, termed 6WK and 5LWK, were selected for chemical synthesis and experimental functional assay. The agonist activity by immunoblotting and immunocytochemistry was determined following the NF-kappaBp65 phosphorylation (p-NF-kappaBp65) and the nuclear translocation of the NF-kappaBp65 subunit from the cytosol, respectively. HeLa cells stably expressing a S. salar TLR5 chimeric form (TLR5c7) showed increased p-NF-kappaBp65 levels regarding extracts from flagellin-treated cells. No statistically significant differences (p > 0.05) were found in the detected p-NF-kappaBp65 levels between cellular extracts treated with peptides or flagellin by one-way ANOVA. The image analysis of NF-kappaBp65 immunolabeled cells obtained by confocal microscopy showed increased nuclear NF-kappaBp65 co-localization in cells both 5LWK and flagellin stimulated, while 6WK and SsOri showed less effect on p65 nuclear translocation (p < 0.05). Also, an increased transcript expression profile of proinflammatory cytokines such as TNFalpha, IL-1beta, and IL-8 in HKL cells isolated from Salmo salar was evidenced in 5LWK - stimulated by RT-PCR analysis. Overall, the result indicates the usefulness of novel peptides as a potential immunostimulant in S. salar.
abstract_zh: 基于TLR5表面的结构知识，并利用盲对接平台，设计了一种源自鲑鱼（Salmo salar）截短HMGB1酸性尾部的肽，作为TLR5激动剂。此外，包含了一个以酸性尾部天然N端序列为参考的模板肽（SsOri）。来自每种算法的肽与TLR5胞外域模型的结合姿态，根据对接评分函数和预测的理论结合亲和力进行筛选。最佳肽，命名为6WK和5LWK，被选用于化学合成和实验功能测定。通过免疫印迹和免疫细胞化学，分别根据NF-kappaBp65磷酸化（p-NF-kappaBp65）和NF-kappaBp65亚基从胞质到核的转位，确定了激动剂活性。稳定表达鲑鱼TLR5嵌合形式（TLR5c7）的HeLa细胞，与鞭毛蛋白处理细胞的提取物相比，显示出增加的p-NF-kappaBp65水平。通过单因素方差分析，在肽或鞭毛蛋白处理的细胞提取物中检测到的p-NF-kappaBp65水平之间未发现统计学显著差异（p > 0.05）。通过共聚焦显微镜获得的NF-kappaBp65免疫标记细胞的图像分析显示，在5LWK和鞭毛蛋白刺激的细胞中，核NF-kappaBp65共定位增加，而6WK和SsOri对p65核转位的影响较小（p < 0.05）。此外，通过RT-PCR分析，在鲑鱼分离的HKL细胞中，5LWK刺激后，促炎细胞因子如TNFalpha、IL-1beta和IL-8的转录表达谱增加。总体而言，结果表明新型肽作为鲑鱼潜在免疫刺激剂的实用性。
